title: Calibration role control completion v2: fill 400 missing bootstrap groups
scope: Post-hoc analysis completion using existing predictions, locks, metrics, point tables and frozen bootstrap indices only.

statistical_design.paired: same frozen resample indices for conditions, methods and seeds; seed-wise left-minus-right then average over three seeds
statistical_design.ci: unadjusted percentile 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 1000 paired contrasts; conditional on fixed fitted models/calibrators

calculation: Use frozen bootstrap index rows as record/patient multiplicities. Concatenate four condition scores; per condition apply corresponding scenario weight. Reproduce exact weighted sklearn average precision (tie-group acceleration only if equivalent on actual resamples); raw and Platt-mapped Brier; q90 raw-threshold sensitivity and FP per 1000. Reuse existing 300 draw vectors byte-for-byte after integrity/content validation. Compute only q in {0,0.001,0.005,0.05}; q=0 coverage represented separately in both scenarios although weights are identical.
